ts_hub.frameDoc: floor_*: interchangeable floor variants (identical borders). decal_*: transparent ground details drawn over floor. wall_top: wall mass seen from above; wall_top_edge_X: wall top whose X side borders the floor (edge_e = west wall column, edge_w = east wall column, edge_n = south wall row); wall_top_corner_ne/nw: wall top with inner notch where floor touches only diagonally (south wall corners); wall_face_upper + wall_face_lower: the north wall front face is 2 tiles tall - upper (with the cap band) on top, lower (with the floor contact shadow) directly above the floor row; stack them. liquid(_alt): water/lava/void fill; liquid_cliff_n: liquid cell directly BELOW a floor cell (cliff face + rim at top); liquid_edge_s: liquid cell directly ABOVE floor; liquid_edge_w/e: floor on the west/east side; liquid_cliff_nw/ne: floor to the north AND west/east.
